narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we'll explore the exciting world of linear equations in two variables. We'll start by understanding their general form and learn how to translate real-world problems into mathematical equations. You'll discover how to solve these equations both graphically and algebraically, mastering methods like substitution and elimination. We'll also analyze the conditions for unique, no, or infinitely many solutions, and finally, apply these powerful concepts to solve practical, everyday problems. Let's begin this journey together!
